paragraphs.text:
Your foot slips on a rock, and you plummet face-first into thigh-
deep water. A sudden silence from the mineral-gathering machines 
warns you that you have been spotted. You scramble out of the 
stream and dash back to your comrades, shouting, “Run for it!”
